title: [Whistler's Pass, Cavern]
description: Away from the rumble of the cascading waterfall, a thin rocky ledge follows the eastern wall of the great cavern, its edge overlooking the vast darkness of the pit below.  Moist with clinging water vapor, the uneven walls of the cavern provide few safe handholds for cautious travelers attempting to reach its nether side.  Nearby, a tunnel branches off to the south.

title: [Whistler's Pass, Tunnel]
description: The twisting tunnel opens up into a huge cavern, its ultimate height lost in the darkness above.  An awe-inspiring waterfall, the roar of its passage emitting a thunderous wave of sound through the tunnels, cascades into a shadowy pit at the bottom of the cavern.  Thick clouds of water vapor reach upward from the pit, their curling, snake-like forms dissipating into the cold air.

title: [River Tower East, Alcove]
description: Once in the alcove you are surprised to see a room of quite comfortable dimensions.  A window slit looks out on the log walls of the surrounding stockade and across the choppy waters of Darkstone Bay.  A hooded cloak and a floppy-brimmed felt hat are laid out on a dressing table, and beside them are scattered some notes in an unrecognizable cipher.

title: [Wehnimer's, Tunnel]
description: You are on a broad stone landing, with a series of wedge-shaped stone stairs fanning out before you.  As you look down, they are swallowed up by increasing darkness.  Two torches in crude iron sconces flicker off the clammy walls, casting a harsh, unrelenting light that illuminates a trapdoor just within reach above your head.

title: [Solhaven, Lornon and Shadow]
description: Set between two large gated residences, a low dark building is visible to the north, its dirtied windows and peeling coat of paint imparting a very dilapidated, abandoned look to the structure.  Faint shadows of movement shift within its dark interior, lending an ominous feeling that's supplemented by the silence pervading the area.

title: [Dark Cavern]
description: Rough walls of dark rock surround you to create a small chamber, darkness enshrouding the area like a haze.  Faint light can be glimpsed further north in the cramped tunnel, flickering amidst the blackness.  The air is slightly damp, the silence of the area being broken by the quiet sound of water dripping far off in the distance.

title: [Eye of V'Tull, Entrance]
description: Sparkles of charcoal grey ash slowly drift to the ground where they add to the several inches already resting there.  Wafts of steam and hot air, rising from a dark hole in the rock face, cause the ash to swirl and dance tirelessly while incessant vibrations from deep within the mountain send rocks skittering downward and make the footing unsure.

title: [Eye of V'Tull, Outer Caverns]
description: Heavy ash covers the cavern floor and absorbs much of the sound and light here while hot sulfurous air, rushing in from the southwest, accumulates ash and steam as it passes before continuing on towards the southeast.  Dull vibrations shake the walls and occasionally jar loose small stones that thud into the thick ash.

title: [Depths of V'Tull, Crawlway]
description: The crawlway angles sharply here, making climbing treacherous.  Razor-sharp pieces of crystallized volcanic glass protrude from the ash-covered surface.  The walls of this pipe-like tunnel close in tightly around you, making passage slow going.  Smoky hot silt and soot swirl upward from below.

title: [Depths of V'Tull, Crawlway]
description: Slanting sharply at a near-vertical pitch, the crawlway cuts deeper into the volcano.  This narrow tube seem to be widening ever so slightly through an opening below.  The soot smudged walls tremor around you as magma shifts from beyond the rock.

title: [Ta'Vaalor, Rubicaene Wey]
description: The bustle of the airship docks occasionally ascends into a deafening roar, as shouting sailors climb ship riggings, and dock workers operate winches and nets to move cargo to and from the various vessels.  Foremen and ship captains alike yell orders to the workers, their voices carrying above the din.  A thick metal grate is set into the cobbled street.

title: [Catacombs, Entrance]
description: A vaulted ceiling allows dim rays of light to seep in through the cracks from the grate above.  Flickering shadows of various shapes and sizes play on the walls.  An odd assortment of paper, kegs and other trinkets litter the ground.  Shattered crates and barrels mar the surface of the floor, and almost hidden behind them lies the rusted top of an opened hatch.

title: [Wehnimer's, Tunnel]
description: The stone floor is slimy and treacherous underfoot.  Although you find it difficult to see well enough to progress unaided, you hesitate to feel your way along the clammy, lichen-covered walls.  Water seeps from the ceiling with a constant dripping sound that echoes around you.  Disturbing grunts and squeals emanate from a particularly dark corner of the room.

title: [Catacombs, Rat's Nest]
description: This suffocatingly close room is dark and foul-smelling.  Murky light filters in through a clawed-out hole in the crumbling brick wall on one side of the chamber.  Decaying straw and rotting refuse litter the floor.  From somewhere nearby, you can hear the faint trickling of water.

title: [Cysaegir, Cave]
description: Echoes bounce back and forth over the smooth stone walls of the cavern.  Cylindrical cones of calcite protrude from the ceiling in a haphazard manner.  Pointed spikes dot the surface of the stalactites, and every so often drops of water plummet to the ground, creating small puddles on the floor.  Irregular stone steps lead up to an oval-shaped hole in the wall.

title: [Cysaegir, Cave]
description: A dozen or so torches line the walls of the cave, which probably aids in keeping these walls dry.  Small square marble tiles decorate the surface of an open wood-framed doorway.  Along the back of the cave, broken crates and barrels are piled almost to the ceiling.

title: [Mraent Cavern, Main Quarry]
description: This enormous space was opened out of the mountain by the work of the stonecutters.  Flatbed rail cars loaded with granite lie on a small portion of intact railway, while various hammers, chisels, and other tools sit in steel buckets nearby.  An enormous sculpture fills the center of the room.

title: [Mraent Cavern, Granite Tunnel]
description: A broad ramp leads from the lower tunnels to the main quarry above.  A pleasant sound of falling water reaches your ears from some unseen, distant source.

title: [Mraent Cavern, Waterfall Quarry]
description: An underground river runs through this natural cavern, which has been enlarged and beautified by the stonecutters' work.  The water enters near the ceiling and cascades down a rippled ramp.  Reforming into a rushing stream, the water runs back and forth across the room in a series of channels cut deep into the stone until it crashes against a black marble wall, throwing up a tremendous mist.  The water collects in a large pool at the base of this wall.

title: [Mraent Cavern, Gneiss Tunnel]
description: Some wide stairs lead from the granite quarry above into a layer of gneiss.  Thick, wavy bands of color characterize this stone, which has been formed by the extreme pressure exerted on granite during the formation of the mountain range.

title: [Zaerthu Tunnels, Wide Tunnel]
description: Lanterns hung from closely-spaced wooden beams supporting the dark sandstone walls and ceiling illuminate the wide tunnel.  Broad enough to permit the passage of three or four horses walking in tandem, the tunnel ends in a pair of large gates.  A few tufts of lichen adorn the beams, scratch-marks on the wood revealing that the lichen is regularly removed.

title: [Zul Logoth, Ruby Tunnel]
description: The tunnel has been sealed off directly to the south.  Thick chunks of granite are piled to the ceiling and filled with mortar to try to prevent anyone from proceeding further down the tunnel...or to prevent something from proceeding up the tunnel.  The workmanship is not up to the usual dwarven standards, though, and shrinkage, or seismic activity, or something else totally unknown has caused a narrow but deep crevasse to appear on one side along the wall.

title: [Catacombs, Eatery]
description: A gentle breeze from the open hatch above creates enough disturbances in the air to send tiny particles of dust and dirt sailing through the air.  An old wood burner is slumped over onto its side in the far corner of the room.  A wooden bowl still contains the molded remnants of the last meal served in this morbid place.

A splintered barrel, with a warped and pockmarked flat piece of wood lying atop it looms above several broken crates that once served as a crude table and chairs.  A wooden bowl still contains the molded remnants of the last meal served in this morbid place.

title: [Catacombs, Chute]
description: In the center of the room sits a huge boulder.  In the far corner and missing several rungs, an old rickety ladder leans against the wall.  Only the portion that is eye-level is visible as the rest of it ascends upwards into total darkness.

In the center of the room sits a huge boulder.  Tattered and torn clothing rests among some white ashes and sticks, which protrude from beneath the rock.  Closer inspection reveals them to be a skeleton, which is turning to dust.  In the far corner and missing several rungs, an old rickety ladder leans against the wall.  Only the portion that is eye-level is visible as the rest of it ascends upwards into total darkness.

title: [Catacombs, Cavern]
description: A slight breeze stirs the silken-threads of a monstrous cobweb, which almost entirely hides the eastern wall.

A slight breeze stirs the silken-threads of a monstrous cobweb, which almost entirely hides the eastern wall.  From a niche directly above what serves as a dining table for the denizens, eerily red glowing eyes shine brightly.  Piles of shredded clothing, helmets and other items lie in the corner.

title: [Smokey Cave, Cavern]
description: The floor of this small cavern dips at the center to form a small basin.  The black grit that seems to cover everything has collected in the depression.  The thick collection of grit moves in waves when it is disturbed, almost as if it were a liquid.

title: [Blackened Cave, Cavern]
description: A faint, greenish light fills this cavern.  You notice that the light stems from the lichen-covered walls.  In spaces between the lichen, flow a few grainy rivulets.  The ground is covered with heaps of dark grit, which makes walking rather difficult.  A jagged crevice can be seen in the shadows.

title: [Blackened Cave, Cavern]
description: In the darkness you can barely make out an old tree trunk propped up against a ledge.  Someone has gone to great trouble to drag the trunk in here and hoist it against the ledge.  If safety awaits up there, it was bought with a lot of sweat.

title: [Blackened Cave, Ledge]
description: This ledge might not be very large, but a modicum of safety certainly outweighs any inconvenience.  There is evidence that someone has tried to enlarge the ledge by chipping at the walls.  Pieces of rock are strewn all about.  An old tree trunk leans against the lip of the ledge.

title: [Catacombs, East-West Tunnel]
description: This smallish, circular chamber seems to mark the beginning of a series of branching tunnels.  To the east, a long passage recedes into the murk, while a narrower one leads southwest.  Sepulchers line the walls, broken into at random intervals.  A tangle of roots on the northwest side of the chamber conceals the source of a tiny streamlet.  A channel in the floor of the tunnel cradles the trickling water.

title: [Catacombs, Narrow Corridor]
description: A solidly constructed, well-maintained passage leads west.  The crumbling brick walls have been plastered over with lime to keep them intact and small shelves built into the brick still contain tools and supplies used to dig out the niches for the tombs in the catacombs.

title: [Catacombs, Twisting Tunnels]
description: A cave-in some time in the distant past must have sealed off the western extension of the manmade tunnel here.  Pristinely clear water cascades in waves over the heap of rubble left in the wake of the collapse, forming a limpid pool at its base.  Overflow from the pool runs off eastward down the center of the floor along a time-worn channel.

title: [Catacombs, Muddy Bend]
description: Dirt and rock, held together by stout, ancient tree roots, are all that is left of the walls here.  An old cave-in reduced the original tunnel to a mass of jumbled rubble beneath you.  Mud and loose stones line the sides of the passage, and the earthen roof is just high enough for you to stand up.  A thin trickle of glassy water flows eastward and down the rubble pile, from a large chamber just to the north.

title: [Catacombs, Beneath a Well]
description: The columnar stone shaft of an old well punctures the vaulted ceiling above and extends about halfway to the ground.  Directly beneath is the glassy surface of a spring-fed lake of unsurpassed crystalline beauty.  Diffuse light refracts off the lake and casts multihued reflections on the walls, as though filtered through a thousand tiny prisms of Elven devising.  The scene is so enchanting, you almost forget the harsh, muffled sounds echoing down the well.

title: [Town Well]
description: The old well is made of flat stones built up around a circular opening.  A slate roof overhangs the opening, keeping the drinking water clear and refreshing.  Several skin water buckets, with long ropes attached, are scattered on the hard-packed earth surrounding the well.

title: [Dark Tunnel]
description: The cavern's ceiling is lost in the cloying darkness above, and quiet dripping sounds rebound and echo about the massive chamber.  Two flickering torches are set upon the craggy grey walls, casting an uneasy light into the shadows that shrouds the chamber.  The air is mildly chilly deep within the embrace of the earth, and the faint scent of decaying flesh hangs in the air like a fog.

title: [Shrine of Transformation, Altar]
description: Waiting at the end of the slope is a chamber ensconced in curving walls of blackened, blistered glass.  The shrine resides in sullen dimness alleviated only by pulses of emerald light from deep within the translucent barrier.  An immense slab of stygian granite, chased in patterns of molten copper and gold, dominates the center of the room.  Deep channels are burned out of the stone of the floor, their exacting, sinuous routes weaving a radiating and serpentine pattern around the black altar.

title: [Underground, Small Cavern]
description: A few hastily placed half-rotting timbers help to support the roof, and rough chunks of stone and dirt hacked from the tunnel cover most of the floor.  A few skeletons lie on the uneven dirt floor of the low cavern, their mouths agape and a few stringy bits of dirty hair still clinging to their pale yellow crowns.  Faint rivulets of muddy water trickle steadily down the rough walls, collecting in shallow puddles that seep across the chamber floor.

title: [Caverns, Tunnel]
description: A cramped, narrow tunnel leads to the west, a faint scent of musty stone and stale air wafting from within.  A few scattered shards of bone lie half-buried in the dirt still heaped at the foot of the roughly cut walls.

title: [Luinne Bheinn, Outer Watch]
description: The meandering pathway runs up to a steep cliff thrice the height of man.  Loose rocks edging the cliff blur in the grey of dusky shadows.  A small crack can be discerned in the darkness.

title: [Dubh Brugh, Cavern]
description: A rough granite wall ends the cavern abruptly.  Small rivulets of water cascade down the wall, making its slippery surface glossy.  High above a ray of moonlight parts the far darkness.  A dark hollow has been gouged out of the granite.

A rough granite wall ends the cavern abruptly.  Small rivulets of water cascade down the wall, making its slippery surface glossy.  High above a ray of light parts the far darkness.  A dark hollow has been gouged out of the granite.

title: [Sea Caverns, Storage Chamber]
description: Boxes and sacks are jumbled together in this small, round chamber.  A thick swarm of flies buzzes about, and various sorts of beetles work over the foodstuffs stored here.  Some rusted cookware hangs from hooks on the wall.

title: [Sea Caverns, Lower Level]
description: Moss clings to the walls of this small, chilly cavern.  The smashed remains of a barrel rot in one corner.  A cool draft blows toward the east, and progress to the south is blocked by a crude but sturdy gate.

title: [Zul Logoth, Ametrine Tunnel]
description: A lone stalactite has been painted with swirls of deep amethyst and streaks of sunny yellow-gold.  Elaborate feats of dwarven masonry stand on display out in front of an expansive storefront.  Idle chatter between shopkeepers, patrons, and neighbors runs together with the heavy footsteps of passersby.  Growing in the shadowed nooks of the tunnel are small clumps of softly glowing blue-green moss.
a.location: the tunnels and caverns of Zul Logoth

title: [Subterranean Siegecraft]
description: A blackened ironwork spiral staircase descends from a wood-paneled ceiling into this luxurious showroom.  Polished mahogany cases with glass windows stand sentinel around the walls, each well lit with brass sconces.  A rich woven carpet rests along a marble floor on which a small desk and chair sit in the center of the room.  Between two of the cases, a marble arch leads to another well-lit chamber of this basement boutique.

title: [Jail, Hallway]
description: Brightly lit by several torches set in iron sconces on the walls, the smoothly tunneled corridor allows no room for shadows to dwell.  Colorful iron doors mark the entry to each cell, each with a different native gem set into the doorway to make differentiation simple.  A set of low steps leads north and down to a lower level of the prison, while to the south, the entry can be glimpsed beyond the burly dwarven guard who stands watch.

title: [Jail, Passage]
description: Highly polished stone walls and floor reflect the dim torchlight here, making it seem more than it is.  Painted iron doors studded with gems indicate the entrances into two more prisoner cells.  A set of low steps leads up toward the exit of the prison, while some steep stairs lead lower into darkness.

title: [Czeroth Caverns, Tunnel]
description: The air is stale and dry here.  Large amounts of debris seem to have settled here when the walls to the southeast crumbled.

title: [Czeroth Caverns, Tunnel]
description: Piles of debris and rocks hamper passage to the northeast as the tunnel continues downward to the southwest.  Fossils pockmark the walls amid small cracks and crevices.

title: [Troll Lair, Long Hall]
description: The stench lessens as you continue along the passage, yet you are still surrounded by filth.  Rotting leaves and gamey-smelling skins litter the floor.  Dried blood stains the walls and floors, which are pitted and marked as if they had been hit with something heavy.  A large skin lies in the center of the hall.

title: [The Pit]
description: You are trapped in a very deep pit.  It really smells of rotted meat here.  If you dare to look about you, you'll see the moldy bones of others who did not escape.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, The Palestra]
description: A large rectangular space formed by a series of walls built between broken towers, opens out to the north.  The remains of several barrack-like buildings, low and roofless, occupy the opposite end of the field.  Positioned in this corner of the field is the statue of a woman perched on the edge of a wall that circles around a deep well.
paths: Obvious paths: north, south, west, northwest

title: [Aqueduct]
description: A dimly lit cavern opens up to allow passage of a glowing emerald stream barely a foot deep.  The stream fills the cavern from wall to wall, though, entering from a tunnel to the north and exiting through a tunnel to the west.  In a small alcove on the eastern wall, steps wind upward, following a chimney into the darkness.  A slight amount of fresh air wafts down from the chimney, but for the most part the air in the cavern is still and cool.

title: [Aqueduct]
description: An intersection of sorts occurs in this widened stretch of the flowing stream.  Glowing emerald water flows in from the north, swirls a bit as the tunnel widens, and then speeds up slightly as the tunnel constricts and heads off to the south.  Another tunnel extends off to the west, but the water in it is placid and unmoving.  On the east wall, a large hole leads off into darkness.

title: [Dry Ring Pool]
description: A raised island sits in the middle of a sunken granite ring, and a granite stairway rises from the center of the ring to a room above.  From the marks all along the sunken ring, it appears that people descended the stairway from above in order to draw water from a sunken ring pool.  Once-colorful frescoes, now faded and cracked, adorn the walls above the outside edge of the pool.

title: [Forgotten Pool]
description: A spacious circular room chiseled directly out of the granite rock bed surrounds what may once have been a shallow pool.  The sides of the pool slope slowly down to the center of the room where they suddenly plunge into a dark hole perhaps six feet wide.  Circular stairs, cut into the walls of the room, rise to the Observatory above, following faded pictures inked into the granite.  A musty odor pervades the area, and there is a noticeable lack of air circulation.

title: [Aqueduct]
description: A layer of water only a foot deep covers the floor of what once was an aqueduct for the city above.  A tunnel runs off in six directions from this point to carry the water to the thirsty residents.  A hole leads upward, and a small amount of light filters down from the hole.  The main illumination, however, is provided by a light green glow from the water underneath.  The air is still and cool, and sounds echo easily off the cramped walls.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, east, southeast, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Eye of V'Tull, Inner Circle]
description: Boulders the size of small huts are melted into the wall frozen for eternity, their slow arduous journey from the bowels of the earth now ended.  Steam escapes from around some of the boulders giving them the appearance of bleeding, as lighter elements are forced through the cracks in the wall with the great pressure of the steam.  To one side, a pile of rubble and rocks cast into a heap by the passage of magma takes on an eerie silhouette within the shroud of drifting smoke and fog.

title: [Eye of V'Tull, Circle of Stone]
description: Huge boulders ring a small, circular area, with a cliff face to protect the far side.  The stones shield the spot from the oppressive heat, making it seem almost temperate compared to the raging fury on the other side of the barrier.  In stark contrast to the rough, blasted surroundings, a statue stands in the center of the clearing, formed of pale grey marble.  Its form is a model of strength and noble symmetry.

title: [The Edge]
description: The trail curves sharply to the northeast, circling jagged stone perimeters and sidling along gullied rents.  Loose shale creates a downward slide south of that, where large, irregularly configured knives of stone stick up out of the scree here and there as the decline disappears into the gloom.  A low hissing can be heard, the sound of steam escaping from unseen fissures elsewhere in the cavern.  It rises and falls in volume, like gusts of wind sighing around a closed window during a storm.

title: [McKyren's Road]
description: A steep slope ends at the edge of a raised path of stone slabs.  Each slab is irregularly shaped, yet fits perfectly into its neighboring tiles, and the surfaces are smooth and level.   This was obviously constructed, since the rock composing it is both a different type and color from the adjacent walls.   The color, a light pinkish red, is a luminous contrast to the gloom and grey stone surrounding it.

title: [Gladiator Falls, Basin]
description: Only found by way of a narrow break in the surrounding trees, the round clearing provides an impressive setting for the wide, crescent-shaped waterfall.  Stones ring the basin, like seats in an arena, covered along the top with thick moss encouraged by the perpetual misty spray.  Jutting out from the rockface behind the cascading water, a wide ledge creates just enough shelter for those who dare to wander close.

title: [Gladiator Falls, Cave]
description: Deafening thunder from the torrents of water makes conversation difficult here, yet provides an awesome display of the raw power of Gladiator Falls.  Sound echoes against arched walls hollowed by the elements.

title: [Muncipal Building, Second Floor]
description: Sparsely furnished, the entire second floor consists of a small landing lit by a pair of giant luminescent toadstools.  A single padded chair sits up against the wall next to a grey steel door, offering a seat to anyone waiting to see the Clan Leader of Zul Logoth.

title: [Municipal Building, Rooftop]
description: Sturdy wooden planks extend out to cover the rectangular roof of the Municipal Building below.  The cavern ceiling overhead is close enough to touch, while down below dwarves are seen coming and going, some entering and exiting the building on official business.  A strong ironwood beam structure suspends a large invar bell next to a long invar horn cradled in a similar supporting frame.  A ladder leads through a trapdoor back down into the building below.

title: [Jail, Passage]
description: Highly polished stone walls and floor reflect the dim torchlight here, making it seem more than it is.  Painted iron doors studded with gems indicate the entrances into two more prisoner cells.  A set of low steps leads up toward the exit of the prison, while some steep stairs lead lower into darkness.

title: [Jail, Passageway]
description: The passageway ends at three extravagant-looking doors.  In the north wall, a gilded crimson door bears a plaque that reads, "Warden's Office," while to the east is a heavy silver door and to the west a heavy golden door.  The latter two doors are obviously cell entrances, evidenced by the heavy locks securing them from the outside.  Some steep stairs lead up to the higher parts of the prison and eventually to the exit.

title: [Wehnimer's, Burrow Way]
description: Huge in size, the underground chamber is set with blazing torches along every wall.  Old wagons have been pulled to one side of the pathway, all of them in need of serious repair.

title: [Wehnimer's, Burrow Way]
description: A narrow path winds through darkened rocks, their edges jagged and jutting out dangerously.  The walls of the burrow glisten slightly, their surface slick with moisture.  Strange, glowing green lichen clings to the walls, creating an eerie viridian glow throughout the area.

title: [Wehnimer's, Burrow Way]
description: Half-formed cobwebs cling to the far corners of the tunnel ceiling, collecting more dust than bugs.  Nearby, a crude wooden ladder leads up to a hinged trapdoor.

title: [Guttin' Goods, Stock Room]
description: A number of featureless and weathered mannequins clutter two corners of the backroom, their bodies sporting an array of fishing attire and accessories.  A few empty ale mugs and some grimy dice rest on top of a stack of unmarked crates.

title: [Solano Hall, Waterfall]
description: This cavern unfolds from the entry gate to rise high into the air, culminating with a curved stone ceiling.  A waterfall cascades down the cavern's center, splashing on a few plateaus before hitting a set of narrow stone steps and disappearing with them into a narrow fissure in the floor.  An ascending set of stairs carved into the rockface leads up beside the falls, and multihued toadstools in pots rest on the steps in even intervals.  Each toadstool reflects off small specks of mica in the walls, illuminating the cavern with a glittering rainbow.

title: [Solano Hall, Geode Landing]
description: The walls are devoid of mica, their rough dark grey surfaces illuminated by several large, glowing toadstools that sprout directly from the roughly hewn stone floor.  A huge geode, split in half and filled with clear lacquer, serves as a bench, and a stone shelf hangs on the wall within arm's reach.  A descending stone staircase allows passage down through a hole in the floor.  Carved directly into the rock, a round window peers out onto the cavern below, and a western passage leads toward the sound of rushing water.

title: [Solano Hall, Waterfall]
description: This cavern unfolds from the entry gate to rise high into the air, culminating with a curved stone ceiling.  A waterfall cascades down the cavern's center, splashing on a few plateaus before hitting a set of narrow stone steps and disappearing with them into a narrow fissure in the floor.  An ascending set of stairs carved into the rockface leads up beside the falls, and multihued toadstools in pots rest on the steps in even intervals.  Each toadstool reflects off small specks of mica in the walls, illuminating the cavern with a glittering rainbow.

title: [Solano Hall, Rainbow Landing]
description: A steep set of stone steps arrives from above, hugging the wall and curving to rest on the circular stone floor.  Although the walls shimmer with rainbow flecks, the main attraction is on the floor.  The center of the floor is perfectly flat and covered by a shimmering quartz mosaic.  The gems have been carefully cut and fitted so that, in the muted light, the mosaic appears almost as one solid gem, shifting from color to color.  A wooden black table laden with shiny trinkets sits beside a western passage.

title: [A Dark Cave, Upper Landing]
description: The upward slope of the cave evens out here to create a stable, if somewhat narrow, landing.  Light from a guttering torch affixed to the wall shows a dark tunnel leading out.  A pair of iron spikes secure the top loops of a thick rope ladder with leather ties, which leads back to the lower portion of the cave.

title: [A Dark Cave]
description: It is too dark inside this cave to see where the ceiling is, but it's somewhere very high up.  A faint glow highlights the sloping floor of the cave, which rises at first in a gentle incline and then sharply into a strange mound that seems to form the back of the cave.  Fastened to the mound is a thick rope ladder with leather ties.

title: [Burghal Enclave, Gem Passage]
description: The mouth of the tunnel opens into a wide crossing corridor running off to the east.  The rough ceiling of bedrock above descends into white tufa walls.  Sturdy brick arches bolster the tunnel's ceiling and are fashioned from unmortared stone bricks.

title: [Burghal Enclave, Shimeraern Var]
description: Terminating at a large, metal-banded door, a rough-hewn tunnel leads away, its further end hidden by several abrupt turns.  The passageway's ceiling plunges through the layers of bedrock in its descent and is periodically reinforced with bricked tufa arches.

title: [Safe Haven, Entryway]
description: This room features a high, vaulted ceiling with carved stone trusses, creating a stark contrast to the cavern floor and rough-hewn passages.  Niches line the walls, the small spaces filled with trinkets and baubles that memorialize fallen defenders and the more noteworthy battles of Mist Harbor.  At one end of the room stands a large mithril-banded hatch which opens inwards.

title: [Safe Haven, Great Room]
description: This large cavern has been arranged as a multi-purpose room, providing shelter in times of need and a gathering or practice space for citizens and militia alike.  Flanked by an archway and a door, the entrance passageway stands opposite a large hearth, constructed of local materials and shadowed by a large tapestry featuring the Mist Harbor crest above it.  The modular nature of the room features some padded benches for meetings that can be pushed aside in times of need.

title: [Safe Haven, Great Room]
description: This large cavern has been arranged as a multi-purpose room, providing shelter in times of need and a gathering or practice space for citizens and militia alike.  Flanked by an archway and a door, the entrance passageway stands opposite a large hearth, constructed of local materials and shadowed by a large tapestry featuring the Mist Harbor crest above it.  The modular nature of the room features some padded benches for meetings that can be pushed aside in times of need.

title: [Safe Haven, Common Room]
description: This cavern serves as a casual gathering place as well as a work space for the militia.  It is cozy and comfortable, with some plush chairs strewn about the space in a somewhat haphazard manner.  In one corner is a large desk which can be used for daily paperwork or reports, or for strategy meetings.  A wide tunnel with the militia crest mounted on the wall above it leads back to the Great Room.

title: [Temple of Rot, Chancel]
description: Leading up to a raised copper dais, the polished floor has a sickly greenish hue.  It is inlaid with tiles of reddish pink stone the color of raw flesh, each etched with a swirl of smoke.  Before the dais, a grisly bronze statue stands, glistening obscenely in yellow-green light flickering from hundreds of candles crowding the borders of the chancel.

title: [Temple of Rot, Altar of Lust]
description: A fortune in copper has been forged into a wide disc that rises over the rest of the chancel. At its center stands an altar of deep green jade, its surface patterned with whorls of stylized smoke.  Tentacles strain from the stone of the altar as if to embrace a supplicant before it, their muscular forms covered with dozens of ghastly suckers.  A single copper step descends back to the nave.

title: [Zul Logoth, Switchbacks]
description: The cavern ends here at a glistening rocky wall.  Carved into the dark stone, a series of wide switchback steps winds upwards, wet from water that trickles down from above.  Small patches of deep red algae can be seen on the surface of some of the surrounding rocks, but they do not quite thrive in the cool, mineral scented air.  Darkness obscures what lies to the north.

title: [Zul Logoth, Cavern Entry]
description: This cave is small, with air that is slightly musty.  Lichen clings to the walls to the southwest, a hint of what lies further in that direction.  Tiny streams flow north out of the cave and down a series of steps just outside an opening in the north wall.  Dark and quiet, save for the sound of the streams and the occasional drip of water, it smells of earth, mold, and slate.

title: [Seething Crescent, Descent]
description: Two crudely shaped pillars of ochre crystal flank the zenith of a porous stone ramp that descends into the depths of the grotto.  Light throbs within the towering formations, its rhythm too regular to be completely random.  At the bottom of the ramp spreads a sweeping edifice of the same unusual material, its twisting spires and strange geometries alien and offensively unnatural.  Moisture in the air beads along the descent, droplets of water trickling inexorably downward into the depths of the earth.

title: [Crystalline Depths, Ramp]
description: Tangles of light throb and die within the cores of two huge crystalline pillars flanking a ramp.  Descending from the rugged gallery of natural rock above, the slope joins with a sprawling plaza of peculiar stone.  The material is riddled with large pores and does not evidence any seams or joining mortar.  It forms wild bridges and tiered terraces with lopsided geometries and strange curvature, all congregating around a mountainous crystal in the center of the phantasmagorical grotto.

title: [Stormpeak Base, Shimmer Cove]
description: Blue-green crystalline waters provide a peaceful and tranquil surrounding, stark in contrast to the frigid and frosty conditions high above.  Though dark, an unhindered view of the bed is still visible and showcases the unmatched beauty of underwater flora and its aquatic companions, while miniscule flecks of silvery blue sprinkled across the massive rock walls project thousands of twinkling lights across the water's surface as moonlight flows into the cavern.

title: [Giant's Ridge, Landing]
description: Completely surrounded by unnavigable boulders save a single moss-covered ramp with a precarious incline, this landing offers some shelter from what appears to be a high-precipitation area beyond.  Luxuriant vegetation rich with deep greens and patterned shrubbery paints a painting-perfect backdrop to this mud and stone-filled space around the natural embankment.  Painstakingly manicured to remove obstacles and unsightly overgrowth, the trail from the landing is precipitous but viable.

title: [Thunder Plateau, Krag Tunnel]
description: While somewhat protected from the harsh conditions outside, this tunnel has dangers of its own that necessitate heedfulness.  Resting at the base of an arduous rise is a pile of aged bones, a collective grave that remains largely untouched save the addition of recent casualties.

title: [Thunder Plateau, Vista]
description: Imposing crags and rock faces dominate the western segment of the plateau, but are far less treacherous than the perpetual lightning strikes that befall the higher elevations.  Extending nearly ten feet from the eastern edge is a narrow rocky shelf that stretches over a gaping cavity of the plateau.  Blending with the current sounds of wind, rain, and thunder is the unmistakable roar of a waterfall from somewhere far below.  A sharp descent leads into a smoky tunnel.

title: [Tholos of Silence, Sanctuary]
description: Creating a haze of silver, starlight filters through the open ceiling above, painting the sanctuary in a dim glow that causes the unornamented marble walls to seem ethereal.  Heady fragrances fill the air at the heart of the space, their source the large, flower-filled urns placed around an alabaster altar that sits upon a raised dais.  Enormous ironwood doors painted in a wash of moss green flank the exit, each piece carved with a silver scythe.

title: [Tholos of Silence, Crypt]
description: Despite the lack of airflow, the underground chamber is humid but much cooler than the rooms above.  Marble walls and floors are polished to a high, reflective sheen, allowing the scant handful of shielded lanterns to keep the space in a twilight-like glow.  Hundreds of niches decorate the walls, each filled with large and small urns surrounded by simple offerings of dried flowers, candles, or incense.  A long white bench rests at the center of the chamber, and a set of wall-hugging stone steps provide egress.

title: [Dragonfly Den, Chamber]
description: A wide, open-ended sleeping niche has been carved out of the limestone cliff, providing an expansive view just below the canopy of trees, as the uppermost reaches begin to thin out.  More sunlight is present here, adding both warmth and light.  In addition to an oak bed with an over-stuffed mattress piled with a thick zaffre blue quilt and matching fat pillows, an oak side table and dresser set off to one side complete the furnishings.  Steel doors suspended on rails are etched with flitting dragonflies filled with bright enamel in jewel-tone hues.
a.location: Dragonfly Den, inside the island town of Mist Harbor

title: [Dragonfly Den, Rainfall]
description: Redwood planks with slight gaps form a solid deck over the limestone ledge, atop which sits an outdoor relaxation bath.  A heavy chain attached to a metal pipe jutting out from the cave wall hovers over a holding tank leading to a punched steel disk suspended at one end of the bathing vessel.  Giant tanik trees surround the outdoor setting, creating a privacy screen, admitting beams of moonlight.  The scented air of the forest and rushing waterfall nearby contribute a relaxing vibration while one reclines neck-deep in hot water.
b.location: Dragonfly Den, inside the island town of Mist Harbor

title: [Whistler's Pass, Rocky Ledge]
description: The sheet of stone comes to a sudden end by swerving to rejoin the mountain.  Just at the terminus of the ledge, a tunnel has been carved into the face of the peak, providing access to the shelter within.  The sharp alpine wind rushes across the entrance, creating a harsh and ominous whistle.

title: [Whistler's Pass, Tunnel]
description: Some light spills through the entrance, but the tunnel quickly turns as dark and chill as krolvin dreams.  The smooth surfaces of floor and walls suggest that the passage was not created by nature.

title: [Whistler's Pass, Tunnel]
description: The omnipresent sound of falling water fills the tunnel, silencing all other noises.  To the south, the tunnel opens into what appears to be a vast, underground cavern and the source of the nearly visible sonic vibrations.  To the north, the tunnel continues onward, fading into darkness.

title: [Whistler's Pass, Cavern]
description: The thunderous roar of the waterfall seems deafening, its descent into the darkness of the cavern sending up thick clouds of vapor.  A narrow, stone ledge works its way around the eastern side of the large cavern, opposite the tumult of falling water.

title: [Golvern and Dragonstail]
description: A massive drilling rig is set against the tunnel's east wall, placed to excavate further into the rock.  The rig looks a bit like a huge metal mole, with a conical screw for a snout.  It is idle just now, as are the dwarves who operate it.  They lean on their picks and grumble.  One kneels to look under the mole and scratches his head.

title: [Surname Registry]
description: Hollowed directly out of the mountain, this office is little more than a formalized cave.  The walls are cold and damp, and the floor is uneven.  An old mining cart holds stacks of bundled paper, and rough plank benches provide somewhere moderately comfortable to sit.  Guttering torches hang in wall brackets, darkening the ceiling with soot.

title: [Basalt Flats, Colossal Boulder]
description: A huge boulder sits next to the trail, towering overhead in the moonlight like a hulking giant watching any who traverses the path.  Its granite composition is foreign to the surrounding basalt, as though the stone was dropped here by something so monumental that hefting such a boulder would pose no difficulty.  Beneath its considerable overhang, the darkness is dense and visibility, nonexistent.

Its granite composition is foreign to the surrounding basalt, as though the stone was dropped here by something so monumental that hefting such a boulder would pose no difficulty.  Beneath its considerable overhang, mosses thrive in the perpetual shade.

title: [Outpost Tunnel]
description: The warm air hangs still in this subterranean corridor, surrounded by the hill on all sides.  Torches mounted along the walls merely illuminate the way, as there are no decorations or furniture to cast their light on.  The tunnel forks, leading toward a tall stone door to the northeast and a square stone door to the northwest.  A round steel hatch claims an unusual place in the tunnel's ceiling.

title: [Depths of V'Tull, Crawlway]
description: You see a sharply descending cylindrical crawlway leading down into the depths of the volcano.  The air here is so hot it's painful to breathe.  This passageway is cramped, and the lava-scorched glassine walls seem somewhat unstable as they squeeze in from either side.

title: [Eye of V'Tull, Inner Circle]
description: This small alcove provides a little protection from the hot air and steam that constantly plague the area below.  Beads of sweat roll down your face and hands as you try and decide if you want to again venture downward back into the chaos.

title: [Cysaegir, Cave]
description: Echoes bounce back and forth over the smooth stone walls of the cavern.  Cylindrical cones of calcite protrude from the ceiling in a haphazard manner.  Pointed spikes dot the surface of the stalactites, and every so often drops of water plummet to the ground, creating small puddles on the floor.  Irregular stone steps lead up to an oval-shaped hole in the wall.

title: [Raechaer's Alchemical Supplies]
description: Colorful dupioni silk tapestries showing various scenes of wizards at work and play conceal one of the shop's stone walls.  The room is illuminated by mullein torches that cast a flickering light along the walls.  Natural recesses in the stone serve as bookcases, housing huge, dusty leather-bound volumes.  A stalagmite draped with an irregular piece of water-stained damask stands in the middle of the room.

title: [Seethe Naedal, Crags]
description: The rocks provide a small resting place in the form of a narrow ledge jutting out from the sheer cliff.  Far below, the city of Ta'Illistim spreads eastward, the valley below it a blur of verdant green.  A large crevasse opens into the cliff's face.

title: [Maernstrike Caverns, Entryway]
description: A sun-bleached skull lies partially buried at the jagged opening of the cavern entrance with what appears to be a baby cave worm slithering in and out of the empty eye sockets.  The rest of the skeletal remains are nowhere to be seen.  A circle of rocks encases charred pieces of wood and ashes, apparently the surviving traces of an old campfire.  Tattered and torn clothing hangs from two tree branches that have been buried deeply in the dirt.

title: [Yegharren Valley, Ravine's Edge]
description: The level ground of the old riverbed suddenly disappears as the ground falls away to the east amid a jumble of boulders and fallen branches where a rushing waterfall must have once filled the still air with mist countless years ago.  A huge formation of piled rocks bounds the northern entrance to the ravine, and the more traversable ground of the forest rises in a shady hillside to the south.  High moors rise beyond the deep ravine, their geography shrouded in clouds of darkening mist.

title: [Yegharren Valley, Narrow Cave]
description: Massive walls of dark granite meet overhead to form a small passage, shielded from the wind and weather.  The walls are patterned with greenish lichen, and clumps of white-capped mushrooms grow in the sparse patches of soil and debris that have collected in the cool darkness of the cave.

title: [Zul Logoth, Emerald Tunnel]
description: A tunnel looms to the north, dark and foreboding.  The approach to the tunnel does not make it any less foreboding.  From the dust outlines in the floor, it seems that many of the pots and toadstools have been removed from this area.  The reason is unclear, but the section is quite dim, with the majority of the light located to the southeast.  Even under the low light conditions, it is apparent that stains the color of dried blood mar the floor just this side of the tunnel's entrance.
a.location: the tunnels and caverns of Zul Logoth

title: [Mraent Cavern, Entrance Tunnel]
description: A low, dark shaft leads down into the heart of the mountains.  A number of large stone blocks have been placed to discourage progress down the tunnel.

title: [Hidden Plateau]
description: A dull stone fountain rests near the base of the chipped marble staircase that leads into the palace ruins.  Scattered cobblestones circle around the fountain and head away to the west, hinting at a long overgrown road.

title: [Hidden Plateau, Ruins]
description: Dilapidated metal fire pits flank the massive, broken doors that form the entryway into the building.  Grime-covered shards of blue, white, and yellow stone form a detailed mosaic of the sun rising over some mountain peaks on the ceiling above.  Smooth marble floors stretch down the halls to the east, marred and scratched violently at random intervals.

title: [Hidden Plateau, Ruins]
description: Two massive chairs rest on a small dais to the east, one splintered and shoved aside to reveal a large trapdoor behind the pair.  Large purple and gold banners hang from the ceiling and walls, moldy and torn.  A small balcony extends from the eastern wall, offering a view of the slopes of the Upper Krag.

title: [Labyrinth]
description: Thin shafts of light stream through tiny openings in the cave roof above, casting a dim light about the area.  Shattered pottery rests near the base of the cave wall, several shards stained with blood.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Labyrinth, Promontory]
description: A small stone promontory stretches outward slightly from the mountainside, overlooking the ground far below.  A gentle breeze swirls about playfully, carrying with it the strong scent of pine.  Stone benches travel around the walled edge of the circular platform, turned to face the handsome statue of a warrior-king.  A steep trail leads away from the simple sanctuary, down and across the cliffs of the plateau.

title: [Plateau's Edge, Steep Path]
description: Slick and frozen terrain prevents passage back up the cliff.  The path continues sharply down the edge of the plateau, ending abruptly several feet above the ground of the frozen slopes below.

title: [Crevice Floor]
description: The confined space here gives you a sense of claustrophobia.  The wind blowing across the top of the crevice creates a haunting melody throughout this area.  A dark hole lies in the southern wall, and it seems that you can just make out the sound of shuffling footsteps coming from it.  The crevice narrows to the east and a narrow path leads out of the crevice.

title: [Gnome Mine, Entrance]
description: This is the entrance to a series of natural caves.  As your eyes adjust to the change in light you see a path worn in the cave floor leading to the southeast.  It looks like the cave off to the southwest is seldom used by the cave occupants.

title: [Catacombs, East-West Tunnel]
description: The tunnel continues here with little noticeable change.  Streaks of yellow and orange deposits smear the walls in places where the aquiferous stone has been cut through.  Droplets from that stone layer trickle down the walls to join the small flow in the center of the room.  Most of the crypts in this section have been picked clean by grave robbers long ago.

title: [Catacombs, Inside Crypt]
description: You curse instinctively as you hit your head on the low ceiling of the crypt chamber, and revile your ancestors under your breath for having been so short.  There is barely enough room to crawl through here, so you quickly glance from side to side to discover anything of interest.  Among the crushed bones and the rubble, you spy a very narrow chute.

title: [Dark Tunnel]
description: The cavern's ceiling is lost in the cloying darkness above, and quiet dripping sounds rebound and echo about the massive chamber.  Two flickering torches are set upon the craggy grey walls, casting an uneasy light into the shadows that shrouds the chamber.  The air is mildly chilly deep within the embrace of the earth, and the faint scent of decaying flesh hangs in the air like a fog.

title: [Underground, Hidden Wing]
description: This appears to be a small shrine of some sort.  Against the east wall is an altar with tarnished religious symbols on it.  The covering is tattered and the three pews here are dry and rotted.  For the first time you notice that the thick dust on the floor is punctuated by shallow footprints, leading you to think that this place is not as abandoned as you first imagined.

title: [Underground Ruin, Sub-Basement]
description: A few scattered bits of broken lumber surround a small trapdoor in the south wall, its surface scarred with raking claw marks and dark stains.  The room is littered with fallen beams leaning awkwardly against the walls and various other broken remnants of the prior inhabitants.

title: [Underground Ruin, Basement Pit]
description: Whirling motes of dust flicker in and out of sight as they pass through the faint beams of light filtering in through the broken trapdoor.  The air is stifling with mold and ancient decay, and a few yellowed scraps of bone litter the moist dirt floor.

title: [Caverns, Tunnel]
description: The tunnel widens into a yawning cavern, its pale grey walls festooned with small glowing patches of greenish lichen.  An arch of rock opens into a small cave in the northern wall, faint beams of light winking in and out of existence from within.

title: [Caverns, Crystal Pool]
description: Spokes of quartz peek out from beneath a large, circular pool, the glassy water illuminated by an eerie glow filtering from above.  Pale white lichen hangs down from the ceiling, casting the chamber in a steady, faint light that shimmers with a rainbow luminescence.  The crystals within the pool continually reflect the unearthly, pristine light, sending off fractured beams across the chamber like twinkling stars.

title: [Caverns, Chamber]
description: A low, darkened tunnel branches off the main cavern to the west, its jagged opening almost resembling a gaping maw.  A few fragile stalactites have broken away from their brethren, lying broken in a damp puddle that collects at the tunnel's opening.

title: [Caverns, Low Tunnel]
description: Phosphorescent moss grows profusely in streaks down the undulating stone walls and in saucer-shaped hollows along the rough cave floor, its pale glow almost making it appear as if the walls were melting.  The floor of the tunnel meanders downward to the northwest, where the darkness emits a faint scent of distant salt air.

title: [Kobold Mines, Entrance]
description: This is a wide section of cavern that slopes rapidly downwards into darkness.  The rock-strewn floor has been worn smooth by the passing of many feet hauling heavy loads.  Several smaller caverns and chambers open up in several directions, but in the uncertain light their contents remain hidden.  Twin streaks of rust vanish downslope into the chill and damp air of this benighted domain.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northwest, down, out

title: [Kobold Mines, Cavern]
description: Dark and damp, this small cavern is silent save for the eternal sound of water, dripping and flowing, echoing dimly as it seeks the depths of these caverns.  Columns of rust-tinted limestone form a lifeless and grotesque forest that waits endlessly for the ages to pass, hoping for a Spring that never comes.

title: [Kobold Mines, Dark Pool]
description: You are standing on a narrow footpath worn into the smooth stone in between the cavern wall and the edge of the dark pool.  As you gaze out over the pool, you notice step-like terraces of slick rock that rise along one wall, creating a multi-layered natural dam.  Water trickles down from level to level, forming a quiet waterfall that pools near your feet.

title: [Kobold Mines, Deep Pit]
description: Standing on a narrow ledge before a yawning black pit, you peer down only to see that the walls soon drop out of sight.  The ground is dry and your footing seems secure, but a feeling of uneasiness hangs in the musty air.

title: [Dubh Brugh, Cavern]
description: A rough granite wall ends the cavern abruptly.  Small rivulets of water cascade down the wall, making its slippery surface glossy.  High above a ray of moonlight parts the far darkness.  A dark hollow has been gouged out of the granite.

A rough granite wall ends the cavern abruptly.  Small rivulets of water cascade down the wall, making its slippery surface glossy.  High above a ray of light parts the far darkness.  A dark hollow has been gouged out of the granite.

title: [Dubh Brugh, Cave]
description: The hollow may be cold and clammy, but it is also impossible for large beasts to enter.  Nasty snarls from somewhere outside the opening almost make it possible to forget the shivering and the darkness.  Almost, but not quite.

title: [Ridge Line]
description: A group of tall, rough cut boulders lies carefully placed in a semi-circle with its opening toward the ocean below.  There are numerous carvings of stone faces, some quite intricate, and others which appear to have been hewn with poor stone tools.

title: [Sea Caverns]
description: It's damp and chilly in the cavern, and only a little moonlight filters in from a hole leading up.  The walls are natural rock, worn smooth by wind, water and time.  The cavern widens to the east.
It's damp and chilly in the cavern, and the only light comes from a hole leading up.  The walls are natural rock, worn smooth by wind, water and time.  The cavern widens to the east.

title: [Sea Caverns, Garbage Chamber]
description: Massive piles of garbage reach nearly to the ceiling.  Bones, scraps and unrecognizables mix together in a rotten morass of greys, browns and black.  Much of it is piled about a fissure in the floor.  The stench is so bad it's almost visible.

title: [Sea Caverns, Refuse Pile]
description: The floor is covered with rotting piles of garbage, apparently dumped from the dark fissure above.  Some of the piles seem to be writhing, though it's tough to be sure through the noxious fog that blankets the floor.  To the southeast, a mass of webs fills the tunnel.

title: [Helga's, Back Alley]
description: The narrow alley, shaded by the overhanging eaves of the stone and wood buildings that rise on all sides, is full of debris, piles of rags and filth.  A broken wooden chair, an old crate and a trash barrel are piled to either side of the smoke-stained oaken door that leads into the back of the building to the south.

title: [Wehnimer's, Burrow Way]
description: Two sconces hang here, one unlit and leaving much of the area in darkness.  Of the portion of the wall that is lit up, the misspelled message  "Breware"  has been smeared in blood.

title: [Zul Logoth, A Damp Hole]
description: Pieces of rock continuously slide down the sides of this crudely dug hole.  Pickaxe markings form gouges along the top edge of the hole, marking the ridge of stone that rims it.
a.location: the tunnels and caverns of Zul Logoth

title: [A Dark Cave]
description: It is too dark inside this cave to see where the ceiling is, but it's somewhere very high up.  A faint glow highlights the sloping floor of the cave, which rises at first in a gentle incline and then sharply into a strange mound that seems to form the back of the cave.  Fastened to the mound is a thick rope ladder with leather ties.

title: [Czeroth Caverns, Rancid Pool]
description: You are in a murky, rancid pool.  Putrid fumes from the pool make your eyes tear and your skin burn.  Although the pool is not deep, it is difficult to gain a sure footing on the slippery bottom.

title: [Czeroth Caverns, Great Cavern]
description: Along the edge of the murky pool, beaded helictite looks like thousands of pearls.  A large outcrop of gypsum flowers grows at the pool's edge.  If not for the rancid odors, this would be a magnificent cavern.

title: [Ravine, Narrow Ledge]
description: A niche in the ravine wall partially conceals the low opening of a small cave.  A rough natural shelf of stone protrudes from the wall next to the cave, its flat surface covered with soot, old wax, and scraps of burnt offerings left over the years.  The greyish splotches of huge bird droppings, most of them dried by the sun and wind, cover the dirt and stone of the ledge.

title: [Ravine, A Small Cave]
description: The walls of the narrow cave are covered with crude paintings of boars and birds and primitive hunting scenes, the broad strokes half-concealed by the effects of crawling lichen and dripping moisture.  The ceiling is stained with the soot of a thousand ancient torches.

title: [Multicolor Mushroom, Chamber]
description: Rising nearly to the ceiling, stacks of empty crates and boxes create makeshift columns around the chamber.  A riot of color coats the stone floor like a melted rainbow.  The variegated ground continues throughout the encircling tunnels.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west, up

title: [Multicolor Mushroom, Alcove]
description: Splotches of bright color stain the surrounding stone from floor to ceiling with only a few uncovered areas offering a glimpse of the natural grey hue.  A variety of notices have been placed around the alcove, most notably a stone plaque and a big hand-painted sign.  Hanging off the back of a chair is a dye-covered apron with dirty gloves shoved in its pockets.

title: [Smuggler's Tunnels, Wide Tunnel]
description: Nearly a cavern unto itself, the tunnel widens considerably into a large chamber illuminated by four torches set along its length.  Two alcoves have been cut into either side of the tunnel, one with stone steps leading upwards, and another with a ladder disappearing into the ceiling.  Somewhere in the darkness, crickets chirp contently.

title: [Targon's Tavern, Backroom]
description: The room is small by human standards, but the perfect size for a dwarf patron or barkeep.  Stacks of crates line one wall and rows of barrels line the other.  A light sprinkling of sand covers the floor on the far side of the room and trails off in the direction of the door leading back towards the bustling sounds of the tap room.  A stuffed rolton head hangs from one wall, an expression of shock and surprise eternally captured on its face.

title: [Smuggler's Tunnels, Wide Tunnel]
description: Nearly a cavern unto itself, the tunnel widens considerably into a large chamber illuminated by four torches set along its length.  Two alcoves have been cut into either side of the tunnel, one with stone steps leading upwards, and another with a ladder disappearing into the ceiling.  Somewhere in the darkness, crickets chirp contently.

title: [Timor's, House Annex Hallway]
description: The hallway floor is warped and uneven.  Ceramic oil lamps hang from the ceiling, bathing the hallway in a flickering light.

title: [Cholgar's Cavern]
description: The walls glisten as water slowly drips down, creating a musty aroma to the shadowy cavern.  Corroded black lanterns provide a soft diffused glow, faintly illuminating a cracked crystal fountain resting between a stack of old crates and a waterlogged bookcase.  A broken chain snakes around a cluster of tarnished bins which are positioned next to a pile of rubble.

title: [Theatre, Backstage]
description: The area behind the stage is in disarray, with wooden props scattered about the floor while fanciful costumes are overflowing from iron-bound chests.  Bins of old paint rest near a few discolored wooden sets, their transformation still incomplete.  A few stools rest before a row of vanities, and a dim passageway leads back to the theatre's auditorium.

title: [Wehnimer's, Burrow Way]
description: Crude symbols have been scratched into the rocks along a tunnel wall here.  Nearby, a crude wooden ladder leads up to a hinged trapdoor.

title: [Scribe, Front Room]
description: The walls of Jenkin the Scrivener's office are honeycombed with scroll and book shelves, all empty.  A thin layer of dust covers the room.  An elegantly penned note hangs from the upper edge of a writing desk in the middle of the room.  Through the archway north, a very large screw-like contraption can be seen.

title: [Wehnimer's, Burrow Way]
description: The fractured remnants of an animal's skull lie amidst a pile of dusty bones in a corner of the tunnel, where it opens into a wide turn.  Nearby, a crude wooden ladder leads up to a hinged trapdoor.

title: [Lower Dragonsclaw, Forest]
description: The evidence of a lightning strike is more pronounced here, and even massive trees have been felled and charred.  One impressive ruin is the huge trunk of a fallen modwir, which lies upon the ground.  Just barely the height of a man, a hole in the trunk shows it to be hollow.

title: [Wehnimer's, Burrow Way]
description: While most of the tunnel is shrouded in darkness, this section is aglow from the orange light of several torches set into the earthen walls.  The passageway is warm from the burning torches, and half a dozen troll skeletons litter the ground.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: Fragrant evergreens cover the side of the ridge here.  Years of battling the elements have stunted and twisted their growth as they cling to the rocks and rubble that clutter the side of the hill.

title: [Monsoon Jungle, Stone Tree]
description: Scratched into the bedrock is this hollow cavern that stretches below a great banyan.  A solitary candle on a simple altar lends illumination and shadows to the pockmarked and irregular formations surrounding the underground den.  An elaborate upside-down tree growing down from the ceiling has been shaped from the banyan's roots and mirrored in carvings that span the stone walls.  A light musk infiltrates as the air is stirred through the cavern, and a subtle but oppressive silence hangs in the air.

title: [Monsoon Jungle, Corpse Copse]
description: What distinguishes this portion of the jungle is the abundant growth of rafflesia, many of the fungi in bloom with their enormous flame-hued flowers.  Lying low to the ground, the parasitic plants attach to the root systems of the multitude of liana vines growing up the trunks and limbs of a tight stand of rubber trees.  The stench given off by the rafflesia blooms is pervasive, similar to that of rotting flesh and attracting flies by the hundreds.

title: [Earthen Cave, Undertree]
description: A rough stone ladder descends from above near the very edge of the room.  The cave's chamber is walled with hard-packed soil, held in by a network of roots that crisscross the walls like the threads of a spider's web, two of which flank a narrow earthen passage.  A large bundle of roots descends from the center of the ceiling in a writhing tangle, some tips curled around glowing crimson globes, creating a macabre chandelier.  Set beneath the roots is a fire pit, while in the background, set into the wall, is a niche containing an ornamented skeleton.

title: [Shadowed Clearing]
description: Dense canopy surrounds this small clearing encasing it in cool dark shadow.  Thin white mist enshrouds a stained stone slab that is surrounded by tiny black gravel in the center of the clearing.  No living thing disturbs the silent grip that stillness holds on this secret, hidden glen.  Over the slab, three small orbs slowly hover, spinning around each other and casting a faint silvery light that mutes nearby colors into varied shades of pale whites, cool grays, and pitch blacks.  Between two trees is an arch of tangled boughs.

title: [Aelotoi Embassy, Receiving Room]
description: A set of broad mosaic stone steps sweeps down into the airy enclave which reaches exceedingly low depths.  Positioned directly at the bottom of the stairs, a sunny flaxen carpet leads to a great haon receiving hall table lined with backless silk-tufted chairs.  An intricate celestial marquetry composes the majority of the vast flooring, balancing with the smoothly carved pale limestone walls.

title: [Ta'Illistim, Linsandrych Var]
description: Polished cobblestones of the var glisten as the sunlight strikes their surfaces.  A thanot-beamed enclave stands to one side of the road, its silvery blue stone shimmering in the heat of the day.  To the other side, a tall, stone palisade encircles a secluded compound.  Flowering greenery grows about a crystal lantern that hangs from an ornately carved alabaster post.

title: [A Dark Tunnel, Staircase]
description: It is very dark and cold here, and the steep stairs underfoot are very slippery.

title: [A Dark Cave, Upper Landing]
description: The upward slope of the cave evens out here to create a stable, if somewhat narrow, landing.  Light from a guttering torch affixed to the wall shows a dark tunnel leading out.  A pair of iron spikes secure the top loops of a thick rope ladder with leather ties, which leads back to the lower portion of the cave.

title: [A Dark Tunnel]
description: It is very dark inside this tunnel.  The floor continues to rise as loose bits of rock crunch underfoot.

title: [Ancient Burrow, Ingress]
description: Crystallized trails of water line the sheer face of a stone hill enclosed by the town walls, glinting brightly above the heads of a pair of dark stone statues.  The cobbles of the road grow fewer as it approaches the yawning mouth of a burrow in the hillside, giving way to the crags of a stone floor several paces within.  Natural light manages little better before it is supplemented by the merry crackle of torches fed by pine pitch, the smell of which lingers on the wintry air.

Crystallized trails of water line the natural stone walls of the ingress.  Placed on either side of the barrier are a series of carved runes paired with rhimar sigils.  A shallow trough runs the length of the walls, cracked and barren of fluids.  Carved black marble stones create a curving path heading north, alternating with white marble inlays.

title: [Ancient Burrow, Plaza]
[Ancient Burrow, Nexus]
description: Veins of natural minerals glitter in the torchlight illuminating the stone walls of the burrow.  Despite the torches' scant heat, immense icicles jut from the high ceiling, ornately carved into fanciful sculptures of sea beasts, including whales and sleek sharks.  A raised plaza sprawls at the lowest portion of the burrow's floor, the dark flagstones spiraling outward from a black marble statue.  A stained pine bench faces the monument, an old oaken tun at its side.

Cobblestones spiral outwards from a dark faceless statue in the center of the nexus.  Veins of assorted natural minerals glitter beneath the cavernous burrow's artificial glow.  Carved twice the height as the rest of the burrow, the ceiling is decorated with several suspended ice sculptures.  A carved ice bench sits facing the statue, with a rhimar-bound barrel next to it.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, west, out
